title: Celine the Seahorse and the Police Submarine
description: When little Celine the seahorse chases a shiny bubble and loses her mama, she stays put and asks a helper, and kind Officer Sonar the police submarine helps her search the reef until they find Mama.

settingBible.visualStyle: 1448x1086 pixels, true 4:3 landscape, bold bright glossy polished 3D children's illustration for ages 3-5 (same bold redo2 style as the library's recent ocean books like Mira the Sea Turtle), soft rounded forms, reassuring expressions, rich turquoise, aqua and deep blue water with warm coral pinks, purples and gold light.
